title: Tracks you can add, rename, group, hide, mute, lock, and move clips between
goal: A person cannot add a track, turn one off, or move a clip onto another track, because today every row is just a layer. Give video documents real tracks you can add, rename, group, hide, mute and lock, and let clips be dragged between them.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): The user cannot 'edit the video tracks, add a new one, disable one, move things to new tracks'. Today a row is a layer, groups flatten, and a clip bar only moves in time (ClipBarDrag.swift). Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?

Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: The document model has tracks holding many clips (PhotonzCore, tested first), with undo through History
Add a video, audio or captions track from the timeline (a + and right-click on the track area); rename by double-clicking the header; group tracks and collapse the group with its chevron
Each header has hide (video) or mute (audio), solo, and lock
Drag a clip along its track and onto another track with snapping to clip edges and the playhead; a drop between tracks makes a new track
Walk at Next defaults does all of the above and photographs it

log.note: triage 2026-09-23: goal rewritten in plain language, the old one kept at the top of notes
